notes: C4/C5/C12 are F-side opposite B-side controllers; plan two short vias at each local BST/SW pair.
U2/U3, L1/L2 and both headers are unchanged. Gate/INA critical copper checkpoint is read-only.
C3 is rotated to put its AUX_PROTECTED positive terminal nearer VIN; C6 input bulk remains unchanged. C7 shifts 0.2 mm; C8 0.3 mm; C2 0.2 mm.
This candidate carries the latest work placement seed, not the old power checkpoint copper. Owner must merge these coordinates into current work and rebuild critical copper.
No uniform distance threshold was used; native same-side courtyards, actual pads, through-holes and contract mounting keepouts were checked.

R65 moves only 0.2 mm, retaining U17 proximity. R71/R72 move near U21 comparator. R1 moves to B(113.9,156.4) and R3 shifts 0.2 mm to B(113.9,154.8); these are low-profile slow eFuse divider parts, not downward connectors; assembled button access remains a height check.
Native DRC on this no-copper placement candidate is zero errors, including actual THT pad, mask and courtyard checks.

Four recorded C4 pad intrusions refer to the OLD locked aux C3/C8 return/output routes in the power checkpoint. Those routes must be regenerated with the moved C3/C8 and new C4; do not merge unchanged old copper. Source-shunt and INA Kelvin placements are untouched.
